estimand: partition-specific angular coefficients of DMzp-25-5log10(c*z_CMB), mag, with separate method/window intercepts
partition_caveat: FP/TF/SN/OTHER are disjoint pooled-catalogue partitions, NOT pure independent method measurements; table3 overlap is reported separately
noise_assumption: centered errors with released e_DMzp diagonal working covariance; selected likelihood, velocity field and shared calibration covariance UNKNOWN
cross_method_covariance: zero ONLY in the assumed diagonal group error model; physical cross-method covariance UNKNOWN
H02_acceptance: HOLD: true selection/shared calibration-velocity law and source null simulations missing

intervals.shared_calibration: eta common to methods/windows is not constrained by method overlaps. Sets describe theta_w+eta. For |eta_j|<=rho, expand nonempty endpoints by rho; eta_j unbounded gives R. No empirical rho supplied.
intervals.joint_set_scope: per-window coordinate projections are outer sets when common gamma across windows is imposed; no window-independence assumption

coupled_intervals.LP_solver: SciPy linprog HiGHS; primal/dual feasibility tolerance 1e-9; projection linear residual must not exceed 1e-7 mag
coupled_intervals.shared_calibration: same gamma_mj across windows; theta_wj+eta_j free per window; eta_j not anchored
coupled_intervals.scope: sharp coordinate projections in declared joint error/calibration boxes for each contrast; not physical confidence and not an empirical calibration estimate

overlap.source_membership_replay: EXACT_ID_SET_MATCH: all raw groups with .01<=z_CMB<=.1; this is an analysis cut, not observational completeness
overlap.heldout_scope: group-hash holdout of already jointly calibrated released distances. Upstream preprocessing used the whole release; this is NOT independent calibration validation. Pair errors hypot(e_left,e_right) are diagnostic weights, not admitted variance.
overlap.selection_scope: conditional source membership and method availability only, not parent targeting probabilities or completeness law
